info.name: KarthikAutomation Practice Store
info.description: Run "Auth > POST /api/auth/login" first; it stores accessToken automatically.

item.name: Auth
POST /api/auth/register — Create a customer account (also logs you in)
POST /api/auth/login — Log in. Returns a JWT access token and a CSRF token; also sets the ka_session cookie
POST /api/auth/logout — Log out the current session
POST /api/auth/logout-all — Log out from every device
GET /api/auth/me — Current user (user is null for guests)
POST /api/auth/forgot-password — Send a 6-digit OTP to the email (read it in the Test Mailbox)
POST /api/auth/reset-password — Reset password with the OTP. Ends all sessions
Account
GET /api/account/profile — Get my profile
PUT /api/account/profile — Update name and phone
POST /api/account/change-password — Change password (other sessions are logged out)
GET /api/account/sessions — List my active sessions
GET /api/states — List of states for address forms
GET /api/account/addresses — List my saved addresses
POST /api/account/addresses — Add an address (max 5)
PUT /api/account/addresses/:id — Update an address
POST /api/account/addresses/:id/default — Make an address the default
DELETE /api/account/addresses/:id — Delete an address
Catalog
GET /api/categories — All categories with product counts
GET /api/brands — All brands (optionally for one category)
GET /api/products — Search, filter, sort and paginate products
GET /api/search/suggest — Autocomplete suggestions (min 2 characters)
GET /api/products/:id — Product details with variants
GET /api/products/:id/similar — Similar products from the same category
Reviews
GET /api/products/:id/reviews — Product reviews
POST /api/products/:id/reviews — Write a review (one per product per user)
DELETE /api/products/:id/reviews/mine — Delete my review
Wishlist
GET /api/wishlist — My wishlist
POST /api/wishlist — Add a product to my wishlist
DELETE /api/wishlist/:productId — Remove a product from my wishlist
Cart
GET /api/cart — My cart with price breakdown
POST /api/cart/items — Add a variant to the cart (adds to existing qty)
PATCH /api/cart/items/:variantId — Set quantity (0 removes the item)
DELETE /api/cart/items/:variantId — Remove an item
DELETE /api/cart — Empty the cart
POST /api/cart/coupon — Apply a coupon code
DELETE /api/cart/coupon — Remove the applied coupon
GET /api/coupons — Available coupons
Checkout
GET /api/delivery-slots — Delivery slots for the next 4 days
POST /api/checkout — Place an order from the cart. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe
Orders
GET /api/orders — My orders (newest first)
GET /api/orders/:orderNo — Order details, items and tracking events
POST /api/orders/:orderNo/cancel — Cancel an order (only before it is out for delivery)
POST /api/orders/:orderNo/return — Request a return (within 7 days of delivery)
POST /api/orders/:orderNo/reorder — Add all available items from an old order to the cart
GET /api/orders/:orderNo/invoice — Download the invoice as an HTML file (Content-Disposition: attachment)
Admin
GET /api/admin/stats — Dashboard KPIs
GET /api/admin/products — All products including inactive
POST /api/admin/products — Create a product with variants
PUT /api/admin/products/:id — Update product details or activate/deactivate
DELETE /api/admin/products/:id — Deactivate (soft delete) a product
PATCH /api/admin/variants/:id — Update price, MRP or stock of a variant
GET /api/admin/orders — All orders
GET /api/admin/orders/:orderNo — Any order in detail
PATCH /api/admin/orders/:orderNo/status — Move an order to its next status
GET /api/admin/returns — Return requests
PATCH /api/admin/returns/:id — Approve or reject a return
GET /api/admin/users — All users
PATCH /api/admin/users/:id — Activate/deactivate a user or change role
GET /api/admin/audit — Audit log
Practice
GET /api/practice/employees — Web-table data: search, sort, filter, paginate
GET /api/practice/feed — Infinite-scroll feed (cursor pagination, 200 items)
GET /api/practice/slow — Responds after ?ms= milliseconds (max 15000) — practise waits and timeouts
GET /api/practice/status/:code — Returns any HTTP status code (100-599)
GET /api/practice/flaky — Fails 50% of the time with 503 — practise retries
GET /api/practice/headers — Echoes the request headers, method and query
POST /api/practice/echo — Echoes any JSON body back
GET /api/practice/redirect — 302 redirect to /api/health
GET /api/practice/basic-auth — HTTP Basic auth protected (user: admin / pass: admin)
GET /api/practice/api-key — Requires header X-API-Key: ka-practice-key
POST /api/practice/upload — Upload a file as JSON {name, type, contentBase64} (max 1 MB)
GET /api/practice/download/:file — Download sample.csv, sample.json or sample.txt
GET /api/practice/cookies — Sets a cookie named practice_cookie
GET /api/practice/graph — Nested JSON for JSONPath / schema-validation practice
System
GET /api/health — Liveness + database check (never affected by chaos)
GET /api/metrics — JSON metrics: request counts, latency percentiles, heap, sessions
Dev tools
GET /api/dev/mailbox — Emails "sent" to an address (welcome, OTP, order updates)
DELETE /api/dev/mailbox — Clear the mailbox for an address
GET /api/dev/db/schema — Tables, columns and row counts
POST /api/dev/db/query — Run a read-only SELECT query (max 500 rows)
Test Lab
GET /api/lab/config — Current chaos settings and bug switches
PUT /api/lab/config — Change chaos settings or bug switches
POST /api/lab/reset — Reset the DATABASE to seed data, clear chaos settings and metrics
